messages:
Alex: Quick check — where's the canonical Grafana/trace slice for First-Byte / TTFT on inference-api? Need p50/p95/p99 and tokens/sec per instance for a quick postmortem.
Priya: Inference -> Latency overview dashboard. URL: https://grafana.internal/d/inference-latency (use the timepicker last 1h). Panels named 'First Byte (p50/p95/p99)' and 'Tokens/sec (by instance)'.
Alex: Nice, do you have the exact PromQL I should paste into Explore for a tenant slice?
Priya: Yep — quick ones below. Replace $tenant with the tenant label you want. Use Explore -> Prometheus.
Priya: ```
# tokens/sec total across instances
sum(rate(tokens_generated_total{service="inference",tenant="$tenant"}[1m]))

# tokens/sec per instance
sum by(instance)(rate(tokens_generated_total{service="inference",tenant="$tenant"}[1m]))

# TTFT p95 (histogram buckets)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le,instance)(rate(first_byte_latency_bucket{service="inference",tenant="$tenant"}[5m])))
```
Omar: For traces: Jaeger query service="inference" and span="serve_request" then filter by trace.duration > 800ms, look for high kv-cache-miss counts.
Lina: If you want a super-quick slice for production routing, set the dashboard var "instance" to the node and the templated var "route" to the route id. Saves a bunch of cross-panel hunting.
Alex: Thanks — what about alert tuning? Current p95 alert is noisy during canary.
Priya: Proposal: alert if p95(first_byte) > 700ms for 5m AND tokens/sec per instance < 3 for same window (indicates backlog not noise). Add a mute for canary-tagged deployments.
Priya: Example alert expression (PromQL):
Priya: ```
(
  avg_over_time(
    histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le,instance)(rate(first_byte_latency_bucket{service="inference"}[5m]))) [5m]
  ) > 0.7
) and 
(
  avg_over_time(sum by(instance)(rate(tokens_generated_total{service="inference"}[1m]))[5m]) < 3
)
```
Omar: Also add a recovery condition to avoid tight flapping: require 3/5 evals.
Lina: I can open a tiny PR to add the tokens gating to the alert rule and a note in the runbook about tenant-slicing. Want me to? @Priya @Alex
Priya: Please, that'd be great. Link the runbook: https://wiki.internal/runbooks/inference-first-byte
obs-bot: Alert suppression rule applied to team=canary for 30m (action by Lina).
Alex: Perfect — I'll run the Explore queries and post a short snippet in the incident doc. Thanks all :thumbsup:
